title: Use requirements and terms
slide_intent: Give the reader a place to find the administrative conditions that accompany the creative rules. A single ordered list makes differences in purpose easier to scan.
strategic_value: Slack can finish its policy section with ownership, changes of terms and a contact route in one location.
demonstration: Seven lettered clauses address conformity, modifications, discretion, termination, rights, warranties and questions. The warranty paragraph uses capital letters within the otherwise mixed-case block.
practical_value: Use the lettered structure to locate a particular condition in this edition and use the final contact item for questions about the guidelines.

content_islands.name: Requirements and rights
content_islands.spec: Stack clauses a through e beneath the heading in the upper-left column. Keep the labels in a narrow hanging indent.

content_islands.name: Warranty and contact
content_islands.spec: Set the warranty clause in capitals and return to sentence case for the contact item below. Preserve the compact measures and open right field.
